policy: Reference inputs fetched by the operator with packaging/scripts/orbis-fetch-references.sh. Orbis never redistributes them and never boots them in place of Orbis without saying so. Hashes were verified on the Orbis build host on 2026-10-26.

artifacts.name: community-initramfs
artifacts.role: firmware source for build_initramfs.py (its init is NOT used: it is GayCorp initramfs-ps4 ~v0.9 with init hard-wired to 'mount LABEL=psxitarch')

artifacts.name: loader-payload-1024
artifacts.role: prebuilt ps4-linux-loader AIO payload (1024 MB default VRAM; vram.txt overrides). Orbis also documents building it from ps4-linux/ps4-linux-loader@d0f4d4c

artifacts.name: reference-kernel-belize-7.1.7
artifacts.role: recovery/comparison kernel only; does not replace the Orbis 6.15.4 kernel
